label: POST-HOC EXPLORATORY MECHANISM ANALYSIS, selected after the reported informative-delay gap. Not a prospectively specified study. All numbers are DESIGN-BASED MONTE CARLO over this panel's own finite draws.
authority: root specification, issue 12 comment 5762860561; runtime handoff reviews/ablation_root_handoff_20260921_1625.md
numbers_live_in: ABLATION_ANALYSIS.json (this file interprets them and adds nothing arithmetic)
hypothesis_under_test: ADAPTER's advantage under INFORMATIVE delay is produced by the two elapsed-cost certificate branches -- the narrowing and collapse of a partially-revealed pair's hierarchy enclosure when the revealed arm succeeded.
prediction_if_true: Disabling those two branches on the SAME draws should SHRINK the informative-minus-non-informative (A minus N) deployment gap.
outcome: NO CLEAR SHRINKAGE AT mu_h = 0.05, AND WIDENING AT mu_h = 0.10. At 0.05 the A-minus-N gap DOES shrink in point estimate, from +0.04750 to +0.04625, a change of +0.00125, but its Monte Carlo 95% interval [-0.00030, +0.00280] includes zero, so the direction is not resolved at this sample size. At 0.10 the gap WIDENS, from +0.31875 to +0.45125, a change of -0.13250 with interval [-0.14018, -0.12482], which excludes zero. The prediction -- shrinkage at both rungs -- is therefore not supported: unresolved at 0.05, contradicted at 0.10. Conditional throughout on these simulator laws and this post-hoc design.
what_the_ablation_does_establish: The certificates produce REAL deploy decisions in every one of the four cells. The paired within-cell difference D = original-deploy minus disabled-deploy is positive with a Monte Carlo interval excluding zero in all four: P05N +0.00187 [+0.00093, +0.00282], P05A +0.00313 [+0.00190, +0.00435], P10N +0.13700 [+0.12946, +0.14454], P10A +0.00450 [+0.00303, +0.00597].

The label change is ONE-DIRECTIONAL on this delivered subset: across all 32,000 paired trials there is not one pair in which the disabled arm deploys and the original does not, and not one retention in either arm. Only three of the sixteen joint first-decision categories are populated, all of the form DEPLOY->DEPLOY, DEPLOY->NO_DECISION, or NO_DECISION->NO_DECISION.

Decisions that survive the ablation arrive LATER under it. Among trials deciding in both arms the disabled arm's elapsed decision time is greater by 29 to 123 ticks depending on cell, every interval excluding zero.
what_it_does_not_establish: It does not show that certificates explain NONE of the delay effect in all regimes. The contrast is measured at two rungs of one law family; a mechanism can contribute in regimes not sampled here, and the within-cell differences show the branches are active in every cell measured.
It does not decide the sign at mu_h = 0.05, where the interval includes zero.
It does not generalise beyond these four fixed synthetic coordinates, and it repairs none of the coarse panel's inherited provenance qualifications.
heterogeneity_across_rungs: The change in the A-minus-N contrast is +0.00125 at mu_h = 0.05 and -0.13250 at mu_h = 0.10, so the intervention's effect on the contrast is NOT constant across the ladder. The four cells sit at 0.00325, 0.05075, 0.52650 and 0.84525 baseline deployment, and that spread is a plausible account of the heterogeneity: at 0.10 the informative cell is near saturation and has little room to fall, while the non-informative cell sits on the steepest part of its own curve, so equal loss of evidence moves them unequally. This is a statement about NONLINEARITY of a correctly paired intervention contrast within a fixed design, NOT a claim that the contrast is confounded. Root, 17:06: 'Different curve positions can explain heterogeneity/nonlinearity of a correctly paired intervention contrast; they do not automatically confound that fixed-design contrast.'
conclusion: The elapsed-cost certificates are load-bearing -- removing them removes real deployments and delays the rest, in every cell measured. But they do not account for the informative-delay advantage in the way the hypothesis predicted: the advantage survives their removal, and at mu_h = 0.10 it is LARGER without them, a measured widening of -0.13250 [-0.14018, -0.12482] that is reported as a result and not downgraded to 'null'. At mu_h = 0.05 the gap shrinks in point estimate by +0.00125 but the interval includes zero. The positive within-cell original-minus-disabled differences answer a DIFFERENT question -- whether the branches contribute deployments -- and they do; that is not evidence for or against the A-minus-N explanation. Conditional on these simulator laws and this post-hoc design throughout.
self_falsification_record: This is the second mechanism hypothesis of mine that the evidence has refused. The first was the CPREFIX comparison, which I had described as showing no advantage when its Newcombe interval [0.00024, 0.02925] excludes zero. The matched ablation was built precisely because CPREFIX was never a one-thing control. It is a one-thing control, and the one thing is not what I said it was.

deviations.what: Attempt 1 of the run wrote its output to experiments/live_ab_validation/results/... instead of the intended results/... directory.
deviations.cause: vsupervise.supervise runs the child with cwd set to the module directory, not the parent's cwd, and run_ablation.py passed the --out path through to the child unresolved. The two processes did not mean the same directory by the same relative string.
deviations.consequence: None scientific. The child completed all 16 shards and reconciled; the parent reconciled an empty directory and correctly reported no completion.
deviations.disposition: BOTH attempts are RETAINED in full and remain in the ledger: disabled_arm/ and disabled_arm_attempt1_misplaced_cwd/. run_ablation.py now resolves --out to an absolute path in both parent and child.
deviations.row_equality_checked_not_inferred: ATTEMPT_ROW_EQUALITY.json. Root, 17:06: 'identical counters alone are not proof of identical scientific rows' -- correct, so the ROWS were compared. All 16 shards are byte-identical between the attempts, both decompressed (96,000 primary rows each, aggregate digest 8e8d67305d0e61eacda6a7e8bb1ad9516ede84415e19a13e80c69c03e679aef5) and in their gzip containers. The earlier 'identical counters, therefore a determinism check' wording inferred row equality from counter equality and was not entitled to; the claim now rests on the digests.
deviations.not_64000_trials: The two attempts are the SAME 32,000 coordinates evaluated twice. They are a reproducibility check and are never pooled, and total usage across both attempts is two executions of one 32,000-coordinate panel.
deviations.lesson_root_stated: 'Future finalization/path repairs should reuse already-complete immutable records when possible.' Attempt 1's records were complete; the right repair was to finalize against them, not to re-run. I re-ran. Recorded so the next path defect is repaired the cheaper way.
deviations.latent_elsewhere: run_powercurve.py passed --out to its child the same way. Root, 17:06: 'a forward absolute-path fix need not rewrite old receipts or await routine permission.' Fixed forward in this commit; no delivered receipt is rewritten and no historical source identity is repaired by the fix. The delivered power-curve runs were invoked with absolute paths and are unaffected.

deviations.what: vpins.entry_point_pins gained two keys, `variant` and `law_weights`, inside run_identity.
deviations.why: Two arms that share every source file, coordinate and config differ only by a runtime rebinding, so without `variant` their receipt digests would be EQUAL and a disabled-arm record would be indistinguishable from an original one. `law_weights` records the P05/P10 weight vectors, which vpowercurve registers into vgen's runtime tables and which vgen.py's pinned bytes therefore do not contain.
deviations.consequence: The `receipt` aggregate is not comparable with receipts written before this change. The source files it digests are unchanged in meaning, and no delivered receipt is altered.

deviations.what: The pre-registered wrapper declared policy='operational' as its default while vgen.state_at_age's default is 'oracle'.
deviations.why_it_mattered: Under global installation vrun._look_fractions calls vgen.state_at_age(sub, ages) with NO policy argument, so the wrapper would have silently evaluated that per-look diagnostic under the operational policy while the original panel evaluated it under the oracle one -- a difference between the arms having nothing to do with the ablation.
deviations.disposition: Corrected before any disabled outcome was evaluated. The transformation itself is unchanged; only the signature now mirrors the function it replaces.

deviations.what: The host was not quiescent during the run: four foreign DTR-AgentEvals processes at ~99% CPU and a load average of 7.86.
deviations.consequence: Affects WALL TIME only. Every quantity reported here is a deterministic function of the draws; the repeat attempt reproduced attempt 1's rows byte for byte under the same load. No foreign process was signalled or inspected.

CORRECTIONS_v1.note: The commit message of 6bdefd1 is immutable and carries the uncorrected wording; these are the corrections to it and to this file's first version.

corrections.was: 'THE PREDICTION FAILS AT BOTH RUNGS' / 'shrinks at neither rung' / 'There is no rung at which disabling the certificates closes the gap.'
corrections.now: 'No clear shrinkage at 0.05 and widening at 0.10.'
corrections.why: At mu_h = 0.05 the point estimate DOES shrink, by +0.00125; only its interval includes zero. I treated 'interval includes zero' as 'no shrinkage', which reports an unresolved direction as a resolved one -- the same convention-mixing this project's readouts exist to prevent.

corrections.was: 'the difference of differences mixes the mechanism with position on the power curve' / 'the contrast does not establish the reverse claim either' / 'read only as no shrinkage anywhere'.
corrections.now: Curve position is offered as an account of HETEROGENEITY across rungs of a correctly paired intervention contrast, not as a confound that invalidates it. See heterogeneity_across_rungs.
corrections.why: Root: 'Different curve positions can explain heterogeneity/nonlinearity of a correctly paired intervention contrast; they do not automatically confound that fixed-design contrast.' The pairing is within-cell and exact; nothing about differing baselines breaks it.

corrections.was: The mu_h = 0.10 widening was framed as a limitation to be reported cautiously, and I asked root whether it should appear in the paper at all.
corrections.now: The widening is a MEASURED RESULT, reported with its paired contrast and Monte Carlo uncertainty, explicitly conditional on these simulator laws and this post-hoc design.
corrections.why: Root: 'preserve and report the measured 0.10 widening with its paired contrast and uncertainty ... Do not suppress it as merely null.'

corrections.was: 'cost narrowing ... is NOT the explanation of the informative-delay advantage' stated without regime qualification.
corrections.now: The hypothesis is unsupported AT THESE RUNGS OF THIS LAW FAMILY. No claim that certificates explain none of the delay effect in all regimes.
corrections.why: Root: 'Avoid a broad claim that certificates explain none of the delay effect in all regimes.' Two rungs of one law family cannot support a universal negative.

corrections.was: 'The repeat produced identical counters ... which is a determinism check across the two attempts.'
corrections.now: All 16 shards are byte-identical between attempts, checked by sha256 over decompressed and container bytes; see ATTEMPT_ROW_EQUALITY.json.
corrections.why: Root: 'identical counters alone are not proof of identical scientific rows.' Correct. The original sentence inferred what it had not checked.

CORRECTIONS_v2.authority: OWNER SELF-AUDIT, 2026-09-21, after delivery and before root's independent validation. Not requested by root.
CORRECTIONS_v2.why_self_audited: Root's next milestone is independent validation of these records. Two defects in my own analysis were cheaper for me to find than for root to find, and both are the kind this project keeps producing.
CORRECTIONS_v2.headline_unaffected: The four paired differences and both contrast changes are EXACTLY unchanged: P05N +0.00187, P05A +0.00313, P10N +0.13700, P10A +0.00450; change in A-minus-N +0.00125 at mu_h 0.05 and -0.13250 at 0.10. Only interval CONVENTIONS on secondary quantities moved, plus one strengthened check.

corrections.defect: I published marginal deployment-rate intervals under a DIFFERENT convention than the delivered coarse panel uses for the identical counts. My normal interval gave [0.0020027, 0.0044973] for P05N's 26/8000 where PC_ANALYSIS.json reports Wilson [0.0022189, 0.0047579].
corrections.why_it_matters: A reader comparing my interval with the panel's on the same count sees two different answers, and at rates this small the normal interval is the wrong one -- symmetric where the true interval is not. This is precisely the convention-mixing these readouts exist to prevent, committed in my own headline table.
corrections.fix: Marginal proportions now use Wilson, via t1_analysis.wilson -- the panel's own function, not a reimplementation. All four cells' original-arm intervals are now BIT-IDENTICAL to PC_ANALYSIS.json's wilson95, which is an executed cross-check rather than a claim of agreement.

corrections.defect: The A-minus-N contrast WITHIN one arm -- a difference of two INDEPENDENT proportions -- used a normal combination of binomial standard errors.
corrections.why_it_matters: This project already used Newcombe's hybrid-score method for exactly this shape of comparison (the CPREFIX difference at mu_h 0.10). Using a different method here without saying so makes two unpaired differences in the same body of work incomparable.
corrections.fix: Newcombe hybrid score. mu_h 0.05: [+0.04253, +0.05247] -> [+0.04266, +0.05263]. mu_h 0.10: [+0.30524, +0.33226] -> [+0.30515, +0.33217]. Small moves; the point is consistency, not magnitude.
corrections.explicitly_not_changed: The CHANGE in the A-minus-N contrast keeps the normal combination of independent cell-specific PAIRED variances, because that is the estimator root specified and a paired variance is not a binomial one. _combine now REFUSES marginal-rate inputs rather than silently combining the wrong variances.

corrections.defect: analyse_cell asserted only that the two arms cover the SAME coordinates. If both arms were short by the same coordinates, the check would pass and prove nothing.
corrections.why_it_matters: A check that agrees with itself is this project's recurring defect shape -- the same one as invariants that compare an operator with itself.
corrections.fix: The intended 2000 x 4 grid is now asserted ABSOLUTELY for each arm before the arms are compared with each other. Verified: all four cells, both arms, exactly 8,000 coordinates, programs 0-1999 x trials 0-3, no gaps and no extras.

must_not_claim: that cost narrowing explains the informative-delay advantage at these rungs -- the experiment was built to test that and the contrast does not support it
that certificates explain NONE of the delay effect in all regimes -- two rungs of one law family cannot support a universal negative
that cost narrowing is irrelevant -- it removes real deployments in every cell measured
that the A-minus-N contrast is confounded by differing baseline rates -- the pairing is within-cell and exact; differing baselines explain heterogeneity across rungs, not invalidity
that the mu_h = 0.05 result shows no shrinkage -- it shows shrinkage whose direction is unresolved at this sample size
that any of this was prospectively predicted, or generalises beyond these four synthetic coordinates
that the paired intervals are coverage statements; they are Monte Carlo uncertainty over this panel's finite draws
